name: Spain (DGOJ) Market Profile

regulator.name: Direccion General de Ordenacion del Juego (DGOJ)

bindingStandards.name: RD 176/2023 de 14 de marzo (entornos mas seguros de juego)
DGOJ resoluciones on per-game technical requirements
bindingStandards.notes: Which instrument holds slot parameters was not confirmed.

otherProhibitions.item: Credit-card deposits prohibited for at-risk / intensive players

saferGamblingEnvironment.value: Session configuration with limits; automatic session termination when a limit is exhausted; option to pre-restrict access to a future session; enhanced protection for under-25s and players with sustained losses; mandatory adherence to DGOJ identity-impersonation prevention systems
saferGamblingEnvironment.notes: Read via a legislation aggregator, not the BOE. AUTOMATIC SESSION TERMINATION on limit exhaustion is a game-session-layer requirement, not just an account-layer one.

selfExclusion.nationalScheme: RGIAJ (Registro General de Interdicciones de Acceso al Juego), DGOJ-operated
selfExclusion.notes: Mandatory checking. NOTE: "RUA" is not Spain's register.

requirement.notes: Historically the Unidad Central de Juegos must be DGOJ-accessible and located in Spain or the EEA.

consultantNotes: The RD 176/2023 automatic session termination requirement reaches into the game session, not just the wallet. Products that only enforce limits at deposit time will not satisfy it.
Watch the cross-operator deposit limit proposal. If adopted, Spain joins Germany in requiring central limit integration, which no single operator can implement alone.
